newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP says Magma made loss in quarter.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP says Magma made loss in quarter.

text.p: Australian resources group The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd confirmed on Friday that its Magma Copper Co subsidiary made a loss in the quarter ended August 31.

Asked at a briefing if he could confirm that Magma made a loss in the quarter, chief executive John Prescott said: "Yes, on a full cost basis." He did not quantify the loss, but said the group had set aggressive targets for cost savings in its copper and the other divisions.
"There are clearly some problems we are addressing but the main impact in copper has been the price," Prescott said.
Referring to the group's response to the weak copper price, Prescott said: "It is focussed not only on fixing problems, but getting superior performance out of well performing assets."
BHP completed its US$2.4 billion takeover of Magma earlier this year. BHP earlier on Friday reported a first quarter net profit of A$287 million, down 22.8 percent from a year earlier.
